headline: Heat Dome Holds: 102° Saturday with Possible Late Storms
lede: Saturday at the lake brings another day of extreme heat with highs near 102°F and heat index values over 106°F. A slight chance of afternoon thunderstorms may offer brief relief before clearing into a warm evening. Stay hydrated, limit midday lake time, and seek air-conditioned shows or indoor attractions.
